  SUBJECT: ECE 3252/ECE_3252 - WIRELESS COMMUNICATION  
  WIRELESS COMMUNICATION [ECE 3252]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                   Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
Missing data may be suitably assumed.  
  
1A)                If a transmitter generates 100 watts of power, calculate the transmit power in (a) dBm and (b) dBW. (4)  
  Next, if this 100 watts is applied to a unity gain antenna operating at a carrier frequency of 900 MHz,  
  determine the received power in dBm at a free space distance of 10m from the antenna. Also,  
  estimate the received power (Pr) at a distance of 10Km. Assume the receiver antenna has unity  
  gain.  
1B)                Contrast the scenarios of free space propagation and the 2-ray model propagation, and outline its     (3)  
  respective impacts on received power as a function of path loss exponent and distance between  
  the mobile station and the base station  
1C)                With an operational frequency of 900 MHz and a distance of 0.1 km between the base station and (3)  
  mobile station, and assuming transmit and receive antenna gains of 1.64 W, calculate the path loss  
  in dB. Determine the received power in dBW and in Watts, given a transmit power of 50 W.  
2A)                Given the power delay profile in the figure below:                                                    (4)  
  
  
  Calculate the coherence bandwidth under conditions where the frequency correlation exceeds 0.5.  
  Analyze the type of fading expected for the following cases: (i) GSM signal with a bandwidth of 900  
  MHz, and (ii) AMPS signal with a bandwidth of 30 kHz.  
2B)                A vehicle is travelling at 80km/hr towards a base station (BS) of height 60m. The mobile station      (3)  
  (MS) is 2km away from BS. The frequency of operation is 900MHz. Compute the received  
  frequency at MS? Justify the statement that the "Doppler effect is causes frequency modulation for  
  both the cases of (i) MS moving towards BS (ii) MS moving away from BS"?

4B)   Consider the following QPSK modulated pilot symbols which are transmitted across a wireless           (3)

  Compute the least-squares estimate of the channel coefficient if the received pilot outputs

4C)   Calculate the exact BERs for BPSK modulation-based communication over a Rayleigh fading               (3)

  values for an AWGN channel.  
5A)   In a selection diversity system with 6 branches, where each branch receives an independent          (4)

  system if it had only 3 branches?
